judged: play zoom 14 / 38 deg (briefs/075/textures) and the 074 flyby grid street view (briefs/074/flyby/grid)
rule: texture and material response only; palette colours unchanged (road #8FAFC1 kept)

surfaces.surface: walls / panel (FacadeKit modules, SideBay, stacks, AlleyWall, ShopFill: the colourway walls)

ours.material: DK_Limestone_Tex + DK_Limestone_Tex__<family> (12 colourways, walls and plinths; 074-H)
ours.maps: wall_panel_neutral_v1 2048 (old facade_panel_v1's luminance, body grain softened 6.7 -> 2.5 %, WALL_SOFTEN 0.35) + facade_panel_v1 normal/mask
ours.where: every kit wall at play zoom, the biggest wall area

old.material: DK_Limestone_Tex and its scene paint copies DK_Limestone_Tex_<hex> (base colour white or near white)
old.maps: facade_panel_v1 2048 (albedo, normal, mask) at 2 m, smoothness from mask x1

surfaces.why: Same sheet, normal and mask as the old; only the cream is moved into the tint so a colourway can land. Open for 074-H: the old sheet's tonal cloud (6.7 % body grain) is what gives the old reel's walls life; the neutral sheet's 2.5 % reads flatter. Noted in notes.md; not changed here (colourways.py is 074-H's).

surfaces.surface: walls / limestone (civic block stone, plinths, cornices)

ours.material: DK_Limestone (legacy .mat, #E7DECA, smoothness .25) + 072-F limestone detail pair (from limestone_polished_v1) at 2 m, bump .3

surfaces.why: Identical material; the detail pair is the old DecoKit's own limestone_polished_v1, which the old flat stone lacked. At play zoom it adds the honed-stone cloud without moving colour.

surfaces.surface: walls / render (matte walls, far LODs, FacadeLit class 0)

ours.material: DK_Render_White (legacy) + colourway copies; FacadeLit layer 0 'render' (limestone_polished_v1 turned and softened)
ours.where: side walls, far LODs, procedural facades

surfaces.why: Same base material and response; texture source is the old sheet.

surfaces.surface: glass / window film (DK_GlassDark in every facade bay)

ours.material: DK_GlassDark on Suborned/DecoKit/GlassSky (fake sky, no probe)
ours.values: glaze #3F7A8E a .65, edge .92, fresnel 3, sheen .12, sky horizon #D8E6E4 -> zenith #86B8E0

old.values: #35585A a .3, smoothness .98, reflections from 17 baked box-projected probes (256 px) of the Skybox/Panoramic street gradient DK_Sky_Street.png

surfaces.why: The old look is its probes and grade, not the material: as URP Lit at a .3 over the charcoal cavity it reads as a black void without probes (brief 048). Ported the old street gradient into the film's fake sky (horizon #D1DBDD, zenith #75A4D6, sampled from DK_Sky_Street.png); glaze and alpha stay. Probes are Glint's (075-A).

surfaces.surface: glass / curtain glass and clear glazing (DK_Glass, DK_Glass_Clear, DK_Glass_Sheen; look.json `glass`)

ours.material: DK_Glass legacy .mat unchanged; café clear/sheen panes from the legacy GlassDark .mat; builder `glass` surface #86CFF2 a .42 sm .92

surfaces.why: DK_Glass is the old .mat byte for byte. The boulevard's glass-slab buildings are a design port (075-C).

surfaces.surface: paving (footways, plots: DK_Ground_Pavement; legacy pieces Pave_Flags_i, TreePit_Flags_i: DK_Pave_Flags)

ours.maps: ground_pavement_v1 2048 (from pave_flags_v1) + normal 1024 + mask 512 at 4 m

surfaces.why: The old reel's pale cream flags; ours read grey-brown beside the colourway walls (074 grid). Now re-centred on the old sheet's own mean #EAE0C4 (also nearer the palette's pavement #F9EFDC); brief 048's one-curve recolour at the cream hue is kept, and the 2048 size (the old 4096 x3 is 64 MiB).

surfaces.surface: roads (the carriageway: DK_Ground_RoadEnamel; asphalt option DK_Ground_RoadAsphalt)

ours.maps: testbed enamel webp 1024 + normal 1024 + mask 512, 2 m sheet x look tile 2 = 4 m
ours.values: #8FAFC1, smoothness .55 x mask .62 = ~.34, env reflection scale .35

surfaces.why: The testbed's speckled enamel read as terrazzo; the old reel's road is a matte sheet with soft tonal drift and sealed patches. New albedo = asphalt_road_v1's luminance on #8FAFC1 (stains at 65 %: at full strength they read as dirt at play zoom), 16 m as the old; normal, mask and fine-aggregate detail are the ground set's (shared with DK_Ground_Asphalt, from the same old sheets), smoothness x1.4 = the old .28 on average. Same keywords as DK_Ground_Asphalt: no new variant. Memory unchanged (1536 albedo = the enamel's three maps' texels).

surfaces.surface: kerbs (world kerb: DK_Ground_RoadPearl; legacy Kerb_Granite pieces: DK_Granite_Kerb, DK_Ground_Kerb)

ours.material: DK_Ground_RoadPearl (testbed marble, #F1EEE6) for the world's kerb line; DK_Granite_Kerb recoloured warm #D0C9BB

surfaces.why: The old reel's kerbs read pale and light; the old granite's blue-grey would sit against the powder-blue road with no edge. The pearl is the capstone's Kerb_Pearl (brief 028); the granite pieces already use the old sheet, re-coloured.

ours.material: sea/harbour: look.json `water` (Look.Water, Glint); kit: DK_Pool_Water, DK_Fountain_Water, DK_Water legacy

old.material: DK_Ocean shader + DK_Sea_Normal (sea); DK_Water #6FB7C4 a .3 sm .98; DK_Pool_Water enamel #3CC3C4

surfaces.pick: split: Glint 075-A owns the sea; kit water stays the old .mats
surfaces.why: The sea's look is shader, sky and grade (075-A). The kit's pool and fountain water mats are the legacy files unchanged. Agreed in notes.md.

ours.material: legacy .mats + 072-F metal detail (brushed_steel_v1) at .5 m, chrome at half bump

old.values: #EDEDED metallic 1 smoothness .95; DK_Steel .7; DK_Steel_Brushed brushed_steel_v1 at .5 m

surfaces.why: Same values; the detail is the old brushed sheet, faint on chrome. Its mirror look depends on the probes (075-A).

surfaces.surface: metals / brass-gold (DK_Gold, DK_Gold17, DK_Accent_Gold, DK_Brass_Civic; crowns DK_Crown_Gold)

ours.values: DK_Gold #D6AE62 (the old hex), metallic .6, smoothness .6; crowns #E3D681 metal .7

surfaces.why: Colour is already the old; full metal mirrored the dark zenith as black studs (brief 009 / 072-G). With 075-A's probes it can be retried. The old gold arch and disc towers are 075-C (crown colour is a palette question, not this pass).

ours.material: legacy Complex Lit .mats + 072-F glaze detail (glazed_tile_ivory_v1) at 1 m, bump .25

surfaces.why: Identical response; the detail is an old DecoKit sheet.

surfaces.surface: roofs (flat roofs: FacadeLit roof layer, roof colours by colourway; RoofKit decks)

ours.material: builder roof surfaces (#F6EBD6) + FacadeLit layer 4 'roof' (asphalt_fine_v1) on up-facing faces

old.material: DK_Roof_Felt (#8F8A83, sm .25), roof decks and roof lawns (DK_Lawn)

surfaces.why: Texture source is the old asphalt_fine sheet; the old reel's roofs read pale from above too. Roof lawns and decks are design (075-C).

surfaces.surface: planters and greens (lawn DK_Ground_Lawn; leaves DK_Leaf_*; planters DK_Faience_Teal)

ours.maps: ground_lawn_v1 1536 (lawn_v1, stripes softened to 45 %, hue 108) + 4 m mowing bands (brief 048) + normal 512 at 8 m

surfaces.why: The added 4 m bands read as a sports pitch down every median in the 074 grid; the old lawn had only its own soft stripes. Bands off, smoothness .12 as DK_Lawn. Leaf cutouts are the old sheets unchanged; the old palms are 075-C.
